verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single Windows support article title, "Install Quick Assist". It names Microsoft's first-party remote-assistance tool but does not describe what it does. Nothing in the pack documents sharing a desktop remotely or connecting to a remote desktop session. missing for 10: documentation describing Quick Assist's screen-sharing or remote-control capability, any evidence of Remote Desktop (RDP) client or host support, depth on outbound versus inbound sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my desktop remotely or access a remote desktop session from my machine
